official_input.responsibility: immutable official statements, attachments, templates, and raw inputs

external_evidence.responsibility: external literature, source records, notes, and legally obtained evidence

planning.responsibility: problem understanding, plans, alternatives, decisions, audits, and claim mappings

code.responsibility: executable project code, with task-specific code below src/<task-id>/ and shared utilities below src/_utils/

result.responsibility: machine-produced results and frozen downstream inputs organized by real task or stable production stage

technical_documentation.responsibility: derivation, verification, reproduction, defense, and teammate-facing technical explanation; never the manuscript workspace

visual.responsibility: generated or publication visuals whose producer and consumer determine whether they live with results or manuscript assets

delivery.responsibility: explicit final-package staging or delivery mirrors; never the working authority

control.responsibility: typed cross-session state and recovery control data

skill_support.responsibility: cross-project workflow support only; never project-specific parameters, results, or answers

navigation.responsibility: optional human navigation that points to authorities without becoming one

cross_role_invariants: one artifact has exactly one platform_role
a path must match its role and class
planning and technical documentation are not manuscript prose
working results do not become delivery artifacts by copying or renaming
navigation files do not become evidence or state authorities
admission never authorizes moving existing inputs or inventing empty placeholders
